Name: Earlier Spring Onion Mastery
Author: BadMoonBeast
Description:
[i]By the time I have eight hearts with those damn children it's always like Y3 and I'm way past any motivation to schlep Spring Onions from Cindersap for a measly 40g a pop... So this aims to fix that.

[/i][b]What It Does:[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlock Spring Onion Mastery at your choice of Two, Four, or Six hearts (default Four).
[/list]
*note the config accepts "Two", "Four", and "Six" written out like that but not numerals (2,4,6). cause I'm lazy
[b]
Recommended:[/b]
Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ to set the config hassle-free.

[b]Please note[/b] that you will require [b]both[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for this mod to work.
